     *, *::before, *::after {
            -webkit-user-select: none !important;
            -moz-user-select: none !important;
            -ms-user-select: none !important;
            user-select: none !important;
            -webkit-user-drag: none !important;
            user-drag: none !important;
        }
       /* Input fields ke andar text select ho sakta hai */
      input, textarea, select {
          -webkit-user-select: text !important;
           user-select: text !important;
      }  

        /* ============================================
           CYBERPUNK NEON THEME - FULL
           ============================================ */
        :root {
            --neon-cyan: #00f0ff;
            --neon-pink: #ff2d95;
            --neon-purple: #b400ff;
            --neon-gold: #ffd700;
            --dark-bg: #0b0b1a;
            --card-bg: rgba(11, 11, 26, 0.85);
            --glass-border: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
            --text-primary: #ffffff;
            --text-secondary: #b0b0d0;
            --text-muted: #6a6a8a;
            --shadow-heavy: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
            --radius-xl: 30px;
            --radius-lg: 22px;
            --radius-md: 16px;
            --radius-sm: 10px;
            --transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }

        /* ============================================
           BASE
           ============================================ */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            outline: none;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        html, body {
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: var(--dark-bg);
            font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        /* ===== PARTICLE CANVAS ===== */
        #particles-canvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ============================================
           SCROLLBAR
           ============================================ */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; height: 5px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border-radius: 10px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-purple)); border-radius: 10px; }

        /* ============================================
           GLASS CARD - NEON BORDER + 3D TILT
           ============================================ */
        .card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.6);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.6);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy), 0 0 60px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.06);
            padding: 40px 30px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
            will-change: transform;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 440px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            animation: cardFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        .card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -2px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            padding: 2px;
            background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-pink), var(--neon-purple), var(--neon-cyan));
            -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: borderSpin 6s linear infinite;
        }

        .card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.04), transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: shimmerRotate 25s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes borderSpin {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }
        @keyframes shimmerRotate {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }
        @keyframes cardFloat {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
        }

        /* ============================================
           LOGO - Orbitron Font
           ============================================ */
        .gyidi-logo {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .gyidi-logo .big {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 48px;
            font-weight: 900;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-pink));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.3));
            position: relative;
        }
        .gyidi-logo .big::after {
            content: '✦';
            position: absolute;
            right: -28px;
            top: 0;
            font-size: 18px;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--neon-gold);
            color: var(--neon-gold);
            animation: sparkle 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes sparkle {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); }
        }
        .gyidi-logo .small {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 700;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, var(--neon-purple));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .gyidi-logo .bazar {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-top: -2px;
        }

        /* ============================================
           LOGIN / SIGNUP BOXES
           ============================================ */
        #login-box, #signup-box {
            display: none;
            animation: fadeSlide 0.5s ease;
        }
        #login-box.active, #signup-box.active {
            display: block;
        }

        @keyframes fadeSlide {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.96); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }

        /* ============================================
           INPUTS - Neon Style
           ============================================ */
        .input-group {
            position: relative;
            margin: 6px 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        input, textarea, select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 16px 18px;
            margin: 6px 0;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
            background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.04);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 400;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: inherit;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        input:focus, textarea:focus, select:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05);
            background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.06);
            transform: scale(1.005);
        }
        input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 300;
        }
        textarea {
            min-height: 80px;
            resize: vertical;
        }

        .input-group .toggle-pw {
            position: absolute;
            right: 15px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            padding: 5px;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .input-group .toggle-pw:hover {
            color: var(--neon-cyan);
        }

        /* ============================================
           BUTTONS - Neon Glow
           ============================================ */
        .btn-main {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--neon-cyan), var(--neon-purple));
            color: #000;
            border: none;
            padding: 16px 28px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 15px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
            margin-top: 8px;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .btn-main::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .btn-main:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4);
        }
        .btn-main:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

        .btn-google {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 12px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            margin: 8px 0;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .btn-google:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1);
        }
        .btn-google .g-sticker {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
        }

        .btn-signup {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 13px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            margin-top: 8px;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .btn-signup:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05);
            border-color: var(--neon-cyan);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-help-center {
            background: transparent;

            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            width: 100%;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 13px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            margin-top: 10px;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .btn-help-center:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1.5px solid var(--neon-cyan);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1);
        }

        .btn-about-us {
            background: transparent;

            width: 100%;

            transition: var(--transition);

            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;

            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.1);
        }
